Laura —

Appreciate the packet and the fast turnaround. High level notes from my side after a quick pass of the CSV:

1) We see the same total of 128 rows and 41 SALeads in a quick filter, but the CRM import shows 95 contacts with the Redwood tag. So the delta is 13 records.
2) In our import logs, we have ~10 rows that failed soft‑match because of email formatting (extra spaces / punctuation).
3) Another ~3 entries look like duplicates where the lead was merged into an existing contact tied to a different source.

Questions / asks:
- Could you share the raw UTM_source and form_id columns for the 128 rows (if not already in the CSV)? Those are the first suspects.
- Please confirm whether BrightStage applied any tag normalization (eg, converting redwood‑sf and rwd to a single canonical value) before sending the CSV.

Proposed next steps:
- Recon call: Monday 10/26 9:00am PT — I can have Ops and CRM on the line to walk the 13 records.
- If you can add a column in Drive called "brightstage_normalized_source" we can run a quick inner join before the call.
- After we reconcile the 13 leads we'll produce a short memo that calls out: (a) where attribution rules diverged, (b) what the net pipeline change is, and (c) recommended normalization rules for future events.

Ben / Karthik / Lauren — tagging you for ops/CRM and sponsorship credit sign off.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
